post.summary: Creates an organization with a control project and a named default project.

400.description: Invalid organization data, default project data, or project metadata.

403.description: Organization creation authority or system-organization membership is missing.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request message for creating an organization.

parameters.name: x-project-id
parameters.description: ID of the system organization's control project.

get.summary: Lists users belonging to the organization selected through its control project.

400.description: Invalid pagination, filtering, or project metadata.

403.description: Organization-user read access is missing or the selected project is not the organization's control project.

404.description: Filtered project not found in the organization.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of users to return. Defaults to 50 and is capped at 100.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Opaque token returned by the previous page.

parameters.name: filter.projectId
parameters.description: Restrict results to organization members with effective access to this project.

parameters.name: x-project-id
parameters.description: ID of the organization control project.

post.summary:
Creates a system user when needed and adds that user to the organization selected through
its control project.

403.description: Organization-user creation access is missing or the selected project is not the organization's control project.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request message for creating or assigning an organization user.

parameters.name: x-project-id
parameters.description: ID of the organization control project.

delete.summary:
Removes a user and their role assignments from the organization selected through its control
project. The system user and memberships in other organizations remain unchanged.

400.description: Invalid user ID or project metadata.

403.description: Organization-user removal access is missing or the selected project is not the organization's control project.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the system user to remove from the organization.

parameters.name: x-project-id
parameters.description: ID of the organization control project.

@type.description:
A URL/resource name that uniquely identifies the type of the serialized
protocol buffer message. This string must contain at least
one "/" character. The last segment of the URL's path must represent
the fully qualified name of the type (as in
`path/google.protobuf.Duration`). The name should be in a canonical form
(e.g., leading "." is not accepted).

In practice, teams usually precompile into the binary all types that they
expect it to use in the context of Any. However, for URLs which use the
scheme `http`, `https`, or no scheme, one can optionally set up a type
server that maps type URLs to message definitions as follows:

* If no scheme is provided, `https` is assumed.
* An HTTP GET on the URL must yield a [google.protobuf.Type][]
  value in binary format, or produce an error.
* Applications are allowed to cache lookup results based on the
  URL, or have them precompiled into a binary to avoid any
  lookup. Therefore, binary compatibility needs to be preserved
  on changes to types. (Use versioned type names to manage
  breaking changes.)

Note: this functionality is not currently available in the official
protobuf release, and it is not used for type URLs beginning with
type.googleapis.com. As of May 2023, there are no widely used type server
implementations and no plans to implement one.

Schemes other than `http`, `https` (or the empty scheme) might be
used with implementation specific semantics.

code.description:
The status code, which should be an enum value of
[google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

message.description:
A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any
user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the
[google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized
by the client.

details.description:
A list of messages that carry the error details.  There is a common set of
message types for APIs to use.

rpcStatus.description:
The `Status` type defines a logical error model that is suitable for
different programming environments, including REST APIs and RPC APIs. It is
used by [gRPC](https://github.com/grpc). Each `Status` message contains
three pieces of data: error code, error message, and error details.

You can find out more about this error model and how to work with it in the
[API Design Guide](https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors).

organization.description: Organization to create. Only name is accepted as input.

projectName.description: Display name for the organization's initial non-control project.

v1CreateOrganizationRequest.description: Request message for creating an organization.

email.description: Email address identifying the system user.

v1CreateOrganizationUserRequest.description: Request message for creating or assigning an organization user.

totalSize.description: Total number of users matching the filter, independent of pagination.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque token for the next page, or empty when this is the final page.

controlProjectId.description: Unique identifier for the project anchoring organization-level administration.

createTime.description: Timestamp when the organization was created.

updateTime.description: Timestamp when the organization was last updated.

projectId.description: Restrict results to organization members with effective access to this project.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user. Output only.

createTime.description: Timestamp when the user was created. Output only.

updateTime.description: Timestamp when the user was last updated. Output only.

emailVerifiedTime.description:
Timestamp when the user's email address was verified. Null until the user
completes their first magic-link sign-in. Output only.

name.description: Name of the user (first and last name).

etag.description:
The ETag for the current version of the user. Helps to prevent
simultaneous updates of a user from overwriting each other ("mid-air
collisions").

If this is provided on update, it must match the server's ETag.

v1User.description: User represents a user in the system.

BearerAuth.description: Access token from VerifyMagicLink or RefreshAccessToken. Format: 'Bearer {token}'
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
